description: Boruto Uzumaki – son of the Seventh Hokage Naruto and Hinata Hyuga – represents the young generation of ninjas full of ambition and strong will. Not only possessing elite blood from two of the most powerful clans in Konoha, Boruto also shows a rebellious spirit, refusing to live under the arrangement of fate.
